laws: INVISIBLE CONTRIBUTION TO PROJECTION != ABSENCE FROM PARENT
SAME PAGE + DIFFERENT GROUND = DIFFERENT PRESENTATION
MULTIPLE PRESENTATIONS MAY SHARE ONE PAGE
presentationIntent: unselected display-contrast candidate; not print stock or page content

semantics.color: 8-bit RGBA; preserve encoded RGB channel values; no linear-light, profile or gamma conversion
semantics.compositing: Pillow Image.alpha_composite(destinationRGBA, sourceRGBA); source-over; straight 8-bit RGBA input/output; pinned imaging-binary integer arithmetic/rounding
semantics.encoder: png-rgba-unfiltered-stored/v0: PNG signature; IHDR RGBA8; one IDAT; row filter 0; zlib 0x7801 stored blocks <=65535; Adler32; IEND; CRC32; no metadata
semantics.measurement: encoded-channel luma proxy Y8=floor((2126*R+7152*G+722*B+5000)/10000); absolute Y8 difference from ground; no linearization, perceptual/physical/WCAG claim
semantics.opaqueChannelArithmetic: N=Cs*As+Cg*(255-As); Q=128*N+16384; Cout=((Q>>8)+Q)>>15; Aout=255; As=0 copies ground exactly
semantics.operation: page source-over opaque solid ground; same dimensions; straight RGBA8
semantics.pixelMatrixIdentity: SHA256(canonical UTF-8 JSON {schema:static-collective/rgba-pixel-matrix/v0,width,height,mode:RGBA} + NUL + row-major RGBA8 bytes)
semantics.quantization: Pillow 12.1.1 AlphaComposite.c PRECISION_BITS=7 and SHIFTFORDIV255; pinned native binary
